title: Convert Integer to the Sum of Two No-Zero Integers
description: Find two integers a and b such that a + b = n and neither contains the digit 0.
pseudocode:
1. for a from 1 to n:
2.   b = n - a
3.   if isNoZero(a) and isNoZero(b):
4.     return [a, b]

steps.note: Check if 1 and 1 are No-Zero integers
